subject: Quick reconfirmation: DataMap next steps + optional cost walkthrough
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@datamap.com>
Cc: procure@datamap.com
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call materials: pricing & estimate attached

Hi Alice — great conversation this morning. Thanks for walking through DataMap's latency and throughput targets; really helpful context.

Attached are the two artifacts I mentioned on the call:
- DataMap-Pricing-Deck-v3.pdf (pricing bands, unit economics, deployment options)
- DataMap-Estimate-2028Q4.xlsx (a simple cost estimate based on your 100 req/s baseline and 30k tokens/day)

Our proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the baseline and any expected seasonal spikes (I used 20% headroom).
2) If helpful, we do a 15–20 minute screen share to walk the deck and line items — I can run through the assumptions in the estimate live.
3) If procurement needs anything (SOW, security summary), flag a contact and we’ll get that over.

Would you be available for a quick walkthrough next week? My available windows: Tue 11/7 10–11am PT or Wed 11/8 2–3pm PT. If those don’t work, send a couple slots and I’ll match.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

If helpful, I can also do a targeted 15-minute runthrough focused only on the estimate assumptions (rather than the full deck). I find that’s the fastest way to unblock procurement and finance questions.

Proposed short slots (PT):
• Tue 11/7 10:00–10:15
• Tue 11/7 10:30–10:45
• Wed 11/8 14:00–14:15

If none of those work, tell me one time that does and I’ll send a calendar hold.

Thanks — and if you prefer I loop in Diego (solutions) for the walkthrough, I can do that.
